incumbent_recipe: per-factor aligned-Z -> winsor_z(2.5 sigma, clip at mean+-k*sd) -> EW-sum per sleeve -> classic z (.zc) -> blend 0.65/0.35. missing rule = strict (any missing named factor in a sleeve => NA composite for that ticker).
selection_authority: canonical_screen_bt portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3 (NW lag-3), IS-only 2005..2018-12. rank-IC advisory only.
primary_metric: IS canonical PORT_t + paired NW-t(lag3) vs rebuilt-incumbent + delta-IR(net_active_recon).

vendor_locked_out_of_scope.C01_SUE_std_denominator: QuantiWise-precomputed field CONSENSUS$sue; raw actual/forecast/history std not separately available -> NOT re-formable
vendor_locked_out_of_scope.C02_EPS_Chg_horizon: QuantiWise-precomputed CONSENSUS$eps_chg_1m/3m fields -> underlying horizon not re-formable (only 1m/3m blend available as distinct vendor fields)

A_common_formation.desc: uniform composite-stage knobs on BOTH sleeves, factor sets + 0.65/0.35 fixed

B_M08_formation.desc: recompute M08 residual momentum from RAWDATA, substitute into def sleeve, else incumbent formation (winsor2.5/classic/strict). a-priori sign +.

C_c04_c06_reformation.desc: recompute C04(ESBR agg window) / C06(TP smoothing) from consensus raw, substitute into core sleeve, else incumbent. a-priori sign +.

dsr_gate.rule: DSR(Bailey-LdP, sweep) HARD >= 0.5 on winner; PORT_t within null-max band => non-informative

production_fidelity: winner + rebuilt-incumbent through STR_1715 carrier: top-20, linear_tilt_to_penalty_qd(lambda=1.5, phi=3, lb=0, ub=0.20/0.10 crisis), liq PIT 2e8, paired NW-t on net active. (06-24 valwt lesson: EW-proxy improvement must transfer.)
pit: C1-C15; cross-sectional transforms per sig_date only; M08/C recompute uses Date<=sig_date only; a-priori signs (no data-driven flip).
success_criterion: small-but-DSR-surviving AND production-transferring: winner IS PORT_t > incumbent AND OOS not collapsed AND production paired NW-t >= 2.0 AND DSR >= 0.5. Else verdict = 'factor-internal parameters saturated' (map completion).
